refusals.when: The caller has no resolvable Identity session (and no head envelope). No flag supplies an asker.
The --ref is not one of discussion:<topic>#Q<n>, plan:<dir>[#phase-<nn>], case:<runId>[#<gate>], or it does not exist in the caller's own checkout.
A required part of the five (what, cause, scope; options and recommendation unless the discovery exception applies) is absent, or the input is not valid JSON of questions-input.v1.json.
A measurable shape rule of questions-input.v1.json is broken: headline length, what/cause length, option count, label length, not exactly one recommended option, blocks missing.
No question has this id in the fold.
The question already has an answer in the local read. A second answer is never written.
The question is not in the state the verb needs: answer needs open; ack needs answered; cancel needs open or answered; a cancelled or acked question takes none.
An agent CLI is among the caller's process ancestors, outside the secretary head's socket route. Guards against mistakes, not attack.
The caller is neither the asker session, nor a session holding the same head role, nor (for a migrated question or one whose asker held no head role) any head session.
Passed through from the Event Store: the platform is not Linux.
Passed through from the Event Store: no repository to hold the store.
Passed through from the Event Store: an append or seal lock was not obtained in time.
Passed through from the Event Store: a read found a broken chain or seal.
Passed through from the Event Store: an I/O failure.
